_comment: Recraft vector logo prompt templates. Variables: {brand}, {subject}, {colors}, {bg}, {shape_block}, {no_text}.
shape_block: Hard shape constraint: the entire logo is fully enclosed inside a perfect {SHAPE} container. Nothing extends outside the {Shape}.

no_text.icon_only: No text, no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere in the image.
no_text.with_brand: The ONLY text allowed is exactly "{brand}" with correct spelling.

icon_only.minimal_geometric: Minimal geometric vector logo icon for {subject}. Abstract symbol, clean geometric shapes, modern branding, flat design, solid colors, simple icon mark, scalable SVG style. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No shadows, no 3D effects, no textures, no cluttered details. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves. {no_text}
icon_only.abstract: Abstract vector logo symbol for {subject}. Dynamic shapes, modern branding, simple icon mark, minimal flat design, professional brand logo. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No shadows, no 3D effects, no textures. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves. {no_text}
icon_only.monoline: Monoline vector logo for {subject}. Elegant continuous line design, minimal outline icon, thin strokes, modern branding, simple scalable logo. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No shadows, no 3D effects, no filled shapes. Line art design with crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves. {no_text}
icon_only.negative_space: Clever negative space vector logo for {subject}. Hidden symbol inside shape, minimal geometric design, modern branding, simple flat colors. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No shadows, no 3D effects, no textures. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves. {no_text}
icon_only.tech_gradient: Modern gradient vector logo for {subject}. Abstract tech symbol, vibrant gradient colors, futuristic branding, smooth geometric shapes. Colors: {colors}. Background: {bg}. {shape_block} No shadows, no 3D effects. Crisp SVG-friendly paths and clean Bezier curves with gradient fills. {no_text}
